messages:
Ethan Ross: Hey team, little snag. I clicked the Okta link in the welcome email and it popped up a chooser with two accounts and then says 'no matching identity'. I did use Sign in with Apple during hiring which created an appleid-linked Google account maybe? Also 1Password shows 'no seat'. What's the fastest unblock so I can read the handbook?

Mira (IT): Welcome Ethan! Apple Sign-in can surface a federated email that doesn't match our directory. Quick unblock: try an incognito window and paste the Okta link, or sign out of all accounts at accounts.google.com. If that still fails I can reprovision the Okta invite to an alias (e.g., ethan.ross+rw@gmail.com) and grant a provisional Drive share to your personal email. Do you have a security key or just phone MFA at the moment?

Ethan Ross: I only have phone MFA. Incognito tried but still hit the mismatch. My offer email was ethan.ross@redwood.com and personal is eross.dev@gmail.com.

Jordan (People Ops): Ethan, I approved the 1Password seat (ticket #12007). Mira, could you add him to the new-hires group so the seat syncs? Priyanka, can you confirm manager sign-off for Drive access?

Priyanka (Manager): Confirmed — welcome Ethan! Please grant view access to the eng-onboarding folder so he can start.

Mira (IT): Done: reprovisioned invite to ethan.ross+rw@gmail.com and shared a provisional Drive folder (Viewer) with eross.dev@gmail.com. Kicked a directory sync and the 1Password seat should appear in ~10 mins. Onboarding Bot created ticket #12008 for IT:okta.

Onboarding Bot: Ticket #12008 created -> IT:okta assigned to Mira. ETA ~2 hours.

Ethan Ross: I got the Drive share and the 1Password email. Thanks! One more Q: later I want to use either a passkey (browser) or a YubiKey. Will those be interchangeable or do I need to enroll both?

Mira (IT): Good question. Passkeys (platform/browser) and hardware security keys are separate credentials in Okta. If you enroll a passkey on your laptop it won't automatically register a YubiKey; you'll need to add each method you plan to use. We recommend enrolling at least one platform passkey + one hardware key for redundancy. See handbook -> IT -> "SSO & MFA" for steps. If you want, I can schedule a 1:1 to walk through enrollment after your canonical account is fully active.

Ethan Ross: Perfect, that'll be helpful later. All good for now — thanks everyone!
